create_nested_vars: create TensorFlow variables from a nested tuple of tensors for PPO algorithm state tracking
reinit_nested_vars: reset all variables in a nested tuple to zeros with optional index-based partial reset
assign_nested_vars: assign tensors to a matching nested tuple of variables in a single grouped operation
lambda_advantage: compute Generalized Advantage Estimation from reward, value, length, and discount tensors for PPO training
available_gpus: list all GPU device names detected by TensorFlow for multi-GPU PPO training configuration
